page_title: LEC 0-0 LAZ | Lecce v Lazio 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

90+3' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+2' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) passes the ball onto Walid Cheddira, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
89' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Tete Morente (Lecce) coming on for Santiago Pierotti.
86' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
85' Fouls committed – 15:6.
84' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) replaces Matteo Cancellieri.
77' The game is interrupted now, Danilo Veiga (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
74' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Ivan Provedel to dive and make a save.
73' A substitution has been made. Manuel Lazzari is replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
73' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
73' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) brought his opponent down. Lecce win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
72' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
72' The total number of attempts is 10:4. Shots on target – 1:1.

70' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
69' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
65' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
64' That's the end of the game for Boulaye Dia, who is replaced by Petar Ratkov (Lazio).
64' The substitution is prepared. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matias Vecino.
64' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mario Gila.
64' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Nikola Stulic will be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Lecce).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lameck Banda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce).
61' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
61' Toma Basic (Lazio) sends a long cross over to Boulaye Dia, but Wladimiro Falcone comes forward to gather the ball.
57' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) took the corner.
56' Toma Basic (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
54' Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a great save to deny Boulaye Dia (Lazio), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
52' Yellow card. Danilo Veiga (Lecce) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
51' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and it's Lameck Banda (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' Mario Gila (Lazio) picks out Kenneth Taylor with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
49' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.

47' Toma Basic (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
44' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
41' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the crossbar! If it had flown a little bit lower it would have been a cracker!
35' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) meets a cross inside the box, but Ivan Provedel wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
32' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Daniele Chiffi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' 5:0 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
27' Lameck Banda (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
24' Lameck Banda (Lecce) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
22' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
21' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) and Omri Gandelman attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
20' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
19' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
19' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel makes a decent save to stop the effort.
18' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Chiffi saw the whole situation.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 39:61.
14' A pass by Nikola Stulic (Lecce) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
11' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' The corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is cleared away by the defence.
8' The ball is cleared after Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lecce.

7' The cross into the penalty area from Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
6' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Chiffi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
3' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. Lazio are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
3' Good defending. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) tries to find Manuel Lazzari inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
1' A clever short pass gives Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Chiffi.
